summary: Validated ChatDetail plan modal bugfix + regression. Datetime-local `min` is now computed in local time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, no 'Z') — fix is correct for UTC-negative timezones (Chile/AR). Activity preselection from plan-status-bar works. Presets render (Mañana 10:00, Mañana 19:00, sáb 15:00) and populate input + enable submit. Full backend regression (test_iteration12_flujomatch.py) 12/12 PASS. Backend propose-plan + accept-plan endpoints return 200 with correct payloads. Found 2 bugs: (1) '+' button (propose-plan-btn) does NOT reset planDefaultActId, so modal opens with previously-selected activity instead of empty; (2) Pre-existing: `plan_status` is never persisted as 'confirmed' on the match doc anywhere in server.py — the green plan-status-confirmed bar never appears after accepting a plan.

critical.issue: plan_status is never set to 'confirmed' on the match doc. server.py only READS m.get('plan_status') in GET /matches (line 1563) and in _maybe_send_plan_nudges (line 1584), but there is NO write of plan_status/confirmed_activity anywhere in the codebase. Consequence: after accept-plan the frontend never renders the green plan-status-confirmed bar; the sticky bar keeps showing '· falta la fecha'. Repro: propose → accept (both 200), then GET /matches → plan_status=null, confirmed_activity=null.

ui_bugs.issue: propose-plan-btn onClick only calls setPlanModal(true) but does not reset planDefaultActId. If the user first opened the modal via plan-status-bar (which sets planDefaultActId to the agreed activity), then closed it, then clicks '+' to propose a different plan, the modal reopens with the previous activity preselected instead of empty. Fix: `onClick={()=>{ setPlanDefaultActId(''); setPlanModal(true); }}` at line 249 of /app/frontend/src/pages/ChatDetail.jsx.

action_items: Fix propose-plan-btn '+' handler: reset planDefaultActId to '' before opening modal (ChatDetail.jsx line 249)

Fix accept_plan endpoint (server.py ~line 1849): also update the match doc with {plan_status: 'confirmed', confirmed_activity: plan['activity'], confirmed_at: now_iso()} so the sticky plan-status-confirmed bar renders after acceptance
critical_code_review_comments: ChatDetail.jsx line 249: onClick handler for propose-plan-btn is inconsistent with plan-status-bar (line 179) — one resets planDefaultActId, the other doesn't.
server.py: plan_status field is read in 2 places but written in 0 places. Dead conditional in _maybe_send_plan_nudges (line 1584).
PlanModal.presets useMemo — currently recomputed on every render (not memoized in useMemo). Minor perf; acceptable for a modal.
PlanModal uses `defaultActivityId` as initial state only. If parent updates planDefaultActId while modal is mounted, act won't update — but since modal is unmounted between opens, this is fine.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 regression tests pass, propose/accept endpoints 200 OK)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (preselection + min-local-time + presets + submission all work; '+' button reset bug found)

seed_data_creation: DB was reset. Re-enabled demo_seed_enabled=true in app_settings and restarted backend to trigger the on-startup seeder — created 10 demo users + activities. Then created a match between demo1 and demo2 with 'Café y conversación' activity (match_id=78befe4b-674e-44ac-aefc-8c6e379be1f6) for UI reproduction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration12 requires demo users seeded (demo_seed_enabled=true in app_settings, then restart backend). Frontend testing browser reported TZ offset 0 (UTC), so the exact `min < toISOString` inequality couldn't be visually observed; however the localNowStr() logic in PlanModal (lines 266-270) is mathematically correct — it subtracts getTimezoneOffset()*60000 before slicing, so in UTC-negative zones (Chile UTC-3/4) the min will be earlier than toISOString by that offset. The datetime-local input correctly has no 'Z' suffix and accepts near-term dates. Presets format: 'preset-YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM'. Only 'Mañana 10:00', 'Mañana 19:00' and next Saturday 15:00 rendered because current time was 21:35 UTC (all 'Hoy X:00' presets already in past).

rca_of_the_issue.original_bug: datetime-local input `min` computed from toISOString() (UTC) shifts min hours into the future for UTC-negative users, blocking near-term date picking (especially iOS Safari mobile).
rca_of_the_issue.fix_verified: PlanModal.localNowStr() subtracts new Date().getTimezoneOffset()*60000 from Date.now() before slicing, producing a proper local-time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM string with no 'Z' suffix. Additionally the modal was refactored to accept a defaultActivityId prop and preselect the agreed activity when opened from plan-status-bar. Presets provide a UX shortcut around the raw picker.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: Login demo1, open /app/chats/{match_id}, click [data-testid='plan-status-bar'] → modal opens with 'Café y conversación' preselected and 3 preset chips; input.min='2026-07-05T21:35' (local, no Z).
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation_open_items: See action_items — fix '+' button state reset and persist plan_status='confirmed' in accept_plan.
